plugins.name: olostep
plugins.description: Turn any website into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data. Olostep integrates powerful web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered answers directly into Claude Code. Scrape single pages, crawl entire sites, map site structures, batch process up to 10k URLs, and search the web — all with automatic JavaScript rendering, anti-bot handling, and proxy rotation built in.

skills.name: answers
skills.description: Get AI-powered answers with citations and sources from the web using Olostep
skills.description_zh: 通过 Olostep 获取附网页来源和引用的 AI 回答。

skills.name: batch
skills.description: Scrape up to 10,000 URLs in a single batch operation using Olostep
skills.description_zh: 通过 Olostep 单次批量抓取最多 10,000 个 URL。

skills.name: crawl
skills.description: Autonomously crawl an entire website starting from a URL, following links to discover and scrape pages
skills.description_zh: 从一个 URL 开始跟随链接发现并抓取网站页面，开展全站自主爬取。

skills.name: debug-error
skills.description: Search the live web for a specific error message and find the real fix — from GitHub issues, StackOverflow, or framework docs. Use when the user pastes a stack trace, says their code is failing, or needs to fix a bug that requires current information.
skills.description_zh: 在实时网页搜索指定错误信息，从 GitHub issues、StackOverflow 或框架文档查找修复，适用于调用栈、代码失败和需要当前资料的缺陷。

skills.name: docs-to-code
skills.description: Scrape API documentation or library docs and write working, up-to-date integration code from them. Use when the user wants to integrate a third-party API, learn a new library, generate SDK usage examples, or write code based on a docs URL.
skills.description_zh: 抓取 API 或库文档，并据此编写可用集成代码、SDK 示例或第三方 API 接入，支持用户提供的文档 URL。

skills.name: extract-schema
skills.description: Turn any webpage into clean, structured JSON matching a TypeScript interface or schema. Use when the user wants to extract products, profiles, articles, or any structured data from a webpage — and get it back as typed, usable JSON.
skills.description_zh: 将网页产品、人物档案、文章等数据提取成符合 TypeScript 接口或 schema 的结构化 JSON。

skills.name: integrate
skills.description: Automatically integrate the Olostep SDK into the user's codebase. Analyzes the project, detects the language and framework, chooses the right integration pattern, installs the SDK, writes all the code, and verifies it works — with minimal prompting. Use when the user wants to add Olostep web scraping, search, or AI answers to their project.
headings: Scrapes — extract content from any URL
Batches — scrape up to 10k URLs in parallel
Maps — discover all URLs on a site
skills.description_zh: 分析用户项目语言与框架，选择接入模式、安装 Olostep SDK、编写并验证代码，为项目增加网页抓取、搜索或 AI 回答。

skills.name: map
skills.description: Discover and list all URLs on a website for site analysis and planning
skills.description_zh: 发现并列出网站全部 URL，用于站点分析和规划。

skills.name: migrate-code
skills.description: Scrape a migration guide or changelog and automatically update the user's code to match the new version. Use when upgrading a framework, moving to a new API version, or replacing a deprecated library.
skills.description_zh: 抓取迁移指南或更新记录，按新框架、API 或库版本更新用户代码，支持替换弃用依赖。

skills.name: research
skills.description: Do thorough, cited web research to help make a decision — compare tools, evaluate competitors, research tech stacks, or assess market data. Use when the user needs a well-sourced answer before making a technical, product, or business decision.
skills.description_zh: 开展有引用依据的网页研究，比较工具、竞品、技术栈或市场数据，为技术、产品和业务决策提供材料。

skills.name: scrape
skills.description: Scrape a single webpage and extract its content as markdown, HTML, JSON, or text using Olostep
skills.description_zh: 通过 Olostep 抓取单个网页，将内容提取为 Markdown、HTML、JSON 或文本。

skills.name: search
skills.description: Search the web using Olostep and get structured results with scraped content
skills.description_zh: 通过 Olostep 搜索网页，返回带抓取内容的结构化结果。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Configure your Olostep API key for web scraping, search, and crawling
skills.description_zh: 配置 Olostep API key，以使用网页抓取、搜索和爬取功能。
